import { rwDel, rwGet, rwPatch, rwPost } from "/src/features/research-workspace/api/client.ts";
export async function listPapers(projectId) {
  const r = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/papers`);
  return r?.items ?? [];
}
export async function uploadPaper(projectId, file) {
  const fd = new FormData();
  fd.append("file", file);
  const r = await rwPost(`/projects/${projectId}/papers`, fd);
  return r.paper;
}
export async function attachPaperAsset(projectId, assetId) {
  const r = await rwPost(`/projects/${projectId}/papers`, { asset_id: assetId });
  return r.paper;
}
export async function deletePaper(projectId, paperId) {
  await rwDel(`/projects/${projectId}/papers/${paperId}`);
}
export async function patchPaper(projectId, paperId, body) {
  const r = await rwPatch(`/projects/${projectId}/papers/${paperId}`, body);
  return r.paper;
}
export async function getPageText(projectId, paperId, page) {
  return rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/papers/${paperId}/text`, { page });
}
